DELETE /admin/users/:userId/roles/:roleN: Remove a role. 409 on removing your OWN school_admin/principal role or the school's LAST managing role
DELETE /classes/:classId: Delete a class — only while EMPTY (e.g. a duplicate created in error)
DELETE /classes/:classId/subjects/:subje: Remove a subject offering from a class
DELETE /hostels/:id: Delete an EMPTY hostel (admin-only; 409 while rooms exist)
DELETE /hostels/rooms/:roomId: Delete a room with NO allocation history (409 otherwise)
DELETE /library/books/:id: Delete a book with NO lending history (409 otherwise)
DELETE /meetings/bookings/:id: — | Cancel (booking parent, host teacher or staff-wide); other party notified
DELETE /meetings/slots/:id: — | Withdraw an unbooked slot (409 if booked)
DELETE /schools/branding/logo: Upload / remove the school logo (PNG/JPEG, ≤1 MB)
DELETE /subjects/:subjectId: Delete an UNUSED subject (409 while any class offers it)
DELETE /transport/vehicles/:id: Delete a vehicle no route uses (admin-only; 409 otherwise)
GET /admin/security/mfa-policy: Per-school "require MFA for all staff" policy (staff = any role but student/parent; super_admin exempt)
GET /billing: Current plan + per-tier quotes (operator-effective pricing) + payment history
GET /billing/status: Light subscription posture (drives the AppShell renewal/past-due banner)
GET /cbt/authoring-options: The caller's authoring scope: their taught subjects/classes (teacher) or all (school-wide staff) — feeds the web pickers
GET /cbt/banks: List question banks (teacher: own + taught-subject banks; admin: all)
GET /cbt/exams: Student: PUBLISHED exams open to them (class-scoped, window-live)
GET /cbt/exams/:id/results: Per-exam results table (names + scores; audited read)
GET /cbt/sittings/:id: Own sitting view (auto-expires on read past the deadline); `answerIndex` present only when finished AND released
GET /exams: List / schedule a sitting (hall, date, time, capacity)
GET /exams/:id/invigilators: Roster / assign an invigilator (staff only — a student is refused; assignee notified)
GET /exams/:id/seats: Seating plan / seat a student list or a whole class (seat 1..N; over capacity → 409)
GET /exams/mine: A student's (or their children's) upcoming exams — hall, time, **seat number**
GET /fees/late-fee-config: Per-school automatic late-fee policy (flat + grace days)
GET /hostels: List / create boarding houses (create: admin-only; warden sees own, head_warden sees all)
GET /hostels/allocations: Room allocations (capacity check is row-locked — no over-allocation under concurrency)
GET /invoices/:id/plan: Installment plan (tranches must sum to total; states derived from payments)
GET /metrics: Prometheus metrics scrape (process + HTTP + per-tenant counters)
GET /notifications/me/preferences: — | Own external-channel prefs (email/SMS/WhatsApp toggles + per-type mutes). In-app inbox always delivered; essential types ignore mutes
GET /operator/admin-appointments: Cross-tenant junior-admin ADMIN_APPOINTMENT oversight (`?state=` filter; read-only — the school's second senior decides)
GET /operator/analytics: Graphical platform business metrics (MRR, ARPA, growth, funnel, churn, module adoption, demographics)
GET /operator/audit: Cross-tenant audit trail, actor-attributed (email + unique id + roles), cursor-paginated
GET /operator/onboarding-requests: Review queue of public onboarding requests
GET /operator/tenant-names: Lightweight id+name list for pickers (single query)
GET /operator/tenants/:schoolId/students: Cross-tenant student view — by ROLE (not-yet-enrolled included), active class names attached; audited
GET /payments/:id/receipt.pdf: Numbered receipt PDF for a POSTED payment (family/staff scoped, audited)
GET /public/plan-pricing: Effective per-tier pricing (operator overrides merged over defaults) — the landing page derives its prices from this
GET /public/schools: Public list of onboarded schools (parent directory; excludes the platform org)
GET /public/schools/:slug/branding: A school's login-page logo + theme by slug (hidden when subscription lapsed)
GET /reportcards/:studentId/remarks?term: A term's class-teacher + head remarks (report-card scope)

GET /students/:id/virtual-account: Read / provision a dedicated NUBAN (transfers auto-credit the oldest open invoice)
GET /timetable/cover?from=&to=: Lessons whose teacher is on approved leave, with any assigned cover
GET /transport/vehicles: Vehicles (driver sees own; head_driver sees the fleet)
POST /auth/login: Verify credentials + MFA + 3-strike lockout, return the signed session JWT + modules
POST /billing/checkout/init: Start Paystack checkout for a chosen tier
POST /billing/dunning/run: Manual delinquency sweep (flips elapsed subs to PAST_DUE)
POST /cbt/banks: Create a bank — `subjectId` REQUIRED for teachers and must be a subject they teach (404 otherwise)
POST /cbt/banks/:id/questions: Add questions (typed rows from the Kahoot-style form or bulk paste; 2–6 choices, server-validated `answerIndex`)
POST /cbt/exams: Create an exam (DRAFT) over a bank — a teacher must target a class where they teach the bank's subject
POST /cbt/exams/:id/request-answer-relea: Maker-checker: request the answer key (only once CLOSED / window ended) → principal approves `CBT_ANSWER_RELEASE`
POST /cbt/exams/:id/request-publish: Maker-checker: park DRAFT → PENDING_APPROVAL + raise `CBT_EXAM_PUBLISH` (approver ≠ author, engine-enforced)
POST /cbt/exams/:id/start: Start (or resume) the caller's sitting — server samples + fixes the question order
POST /cbt/sittings/:id/answer: Save one answer (refused after time is up — the clock is server law)
POST /certificates/issue: Generate an ID card / certificate PDF (**school logo embedded**)
POST /classes/:classId/attendance: Take the daily register (auto-notifies guardians on absence)
POST /classes/:classId/subjects: Assign a teacher to a class-subject
POST /classes/:classId/teachers: Assign a teacher to a class
POST /exams: List / schedule a sitting (hall, date, time, capacity)
POST /exams/:id/invigilators: Roster / assign an invigilator (staff only — a student is refused; assignee notified)
POST /exams/:id/seats: Seating plan / seat a student list or a whole class (seat 1..N; over capacity → 409)
POST /fees/adjustments/:id/decide: Approve/reject an adjustment (must differ from the requester)
POST /fees/disputes/:id/respond: Record the school's evidence response on an OPEN dispute
POST /fees/reconciliation/run: Cross-tenant gateway reconciliation sweep (super_admin; also daily via BullMQ)
POST /fees/reminders/run: Send fee reminders (also runs weekly per school, overdue-only)
POST /guardians: Link a parent to a child
POST /hostels: List / create boarding houses (create: admin-only; warden sees own, head_warden sees all)
POST /hostels/allocations: Room allocations (capacity check is row-locked — no over-allocation under concurrency)
POST /hostels/fees/schedule: Bill hostel rent — admins post directly; a (head-)warden's run becomes a FEE_SCHEDULE approval request (maker-checker)
POST /hr/leave/requests: Apply for leave (routes through the workflow)
POST /integrity/retention/run: Purge minors' telemetry past the retention window
POST /invoices/:id/apply-credit: Apply credit balance to an invoice (APPLIED entry + POSTED CREDIT payment)
POST /invoices/:id/overpayment-to-credit: Move overpaid excess to credit (double-entry: system REFUND + OVERPAYMENT)
POST /invoices/:id/pay/confirm: Verify-on-return: confirm a charge against the gateway if the webhook was lost (idempotent)
POST /invoices/:id/pay/init: Start hosted checkout — Paystack (NGN) or Stripe (USD invoices)
POST /library/loans/issue: Issue a loan (copy claim is atomic — no negative availability under concurrency)
POST /operator/impersonate: Mint an audited, scoped impersonation token
POST /operator/tenants: Provision a new school + its founding admin tier
POST /operator/tenants/:schoolId/admins: Add an admin to an existing school
POST /payments/webhook: Paystack webhook (HMAC-SHA512 verified; logs to `gateway_event`, dispatches disputes / subscription / admission / credits / prepay / dedicated-NUBAN / invoice)
POST /privacy/erasure/:id/review: Controller review of an erasure request
POST /public/onboarding-requests: A prospective school requests to join (homepage CTA)
POST /reportcards/:studentId/generate: Generate a report-card PDF (grades + attendance, **school logo embedded**); `?termId=` folds in that term's remarks
POST /schools/branding/logo: Upload / remove the school logo (PNG/JPEG, ≤1 MB)
POST /security/elevation/:id/approve: Approve elevation (must be a different person)
POST /security/stepup: Mint a 5-minute step-up token for sensitive actions
POST /students/:id/prepay/init: Prepay into the credit balance (hosted checkout)

POST /timetable/cover: Assign a reliever (self-cover 400, double-booking 409; reliever notified)
POST /transport/fees/schedule: Bill transport fees — admins post directly; the head driver's run becomes a FEE_SCHEDULE approval request (maker-checker)
POST /transport/vehicles: Vehicles (driver sees own; head_driver sees the fleet)
